sources.role: native save-state, memory-card and recording behavior
native command line and ROM naming

paths.path: fbneo.ini beside the native SDL executable; the first run creates it and the user edits ROM directories and other options there.
Native FBNeo input and DIP settings are edited from the in-game Inputs/DIP switches dialogs and saved to the game's config file; SDL builds enable joystick input with -joy.
paths.naming: Game-specific configuration is FBNeo's generated config/INI format; keyboard shortcuts include F5 Inputs and the source's standard arcade bindings. No stable portable controller-profile grammar is promised.
evidence: docs:FinalBurn Neo wiki menu_misc (save input mapping to game config)

paths.path: Native FBNeo support folders beside the executable: per-game config, NVRAM/high scores and Neo Geo memory-card files are managed by the frontend; game-specific battery/high-score data is not one universal extension.
paths.naming: Neo Geo memory cards are user-selected files; game/NVRAM and high-score names are generated per driver/game.
evidence: docs:FinalBurn Neo wiki menu_misc (support file paths)

paths.path: Native FBNeo save states are stored in the support-file/savestates directory and can also be opened by filename; active slots are selected in the menu.
paths.naming: .fs save-state files; .fr input recordings. Keys include Ctrl+F10/F10 save and Ctrl+F9/F9 load as documented.
evidence: docs:FinalBurn Neo wiki menu_game (.FS and active slots)

paths.path: ROM sets and required BIOS sets are loaded from directories configured in fbneo.ini; common arcade BIOS sets include neogeo.zip and other driver-defined sets.
paths.naming: Exact filenames/CRC requirements are driver XML/DAT-defined; no single BIOS applies and the upstream wiki does not publish a universal checksum table.
evidence: docs:FinalBurn Neo wiki Command-Line (-listinfo ROM requirements)

paths.path: No external decryption key file; arcade BIOS ROM sets are the only external platform firmware inputs.
evidence: docs:FinalBurn Neo wiki Command-Line and menu_game

paths.path: fbneo.ini beside the FBNeo executable; application settings are written to this INI on exit.
F5 opens Inputs, and Save input mapping writes input/DIP settings to the game's config file; controller bindings are source-generated FBNeo config data.
paths.naming: No stable external controller-profile grammar documented; preserve generated per-game config.

paths.path: FBNeo support directories beside the executable contain per-game config, NVRAM/high scores and selected Neo Geo memory-card files.
paths.naming: Memory-card file is user-selected; other save/NVRAM names are driver/game-defined.

paths.path: Native FBNeo save-state support directory with active slots; direct filenames may be supplied on the command line.
paths.naming: .fs states and .fr input recordings; F10/Ctrl+F10 save, F9/Ctrl+F9 load.

paths.path: ROM paths in fbneo.ini contain driver-required BIOS archives/ROM sets such as the Neo Geo set.
paths.naming: Driver DAT/XML supplies exact names and checksums; no universal BIOS name.

paths.path: The official fbn-mac build stores its launcher/configuration in the app's native macOS data; games can be opened from anywhere, with required parent/BIOS archives in the same directory.
evidence: source:finalburnneo/FBNeo README-macOS.md (official macOS v1.03 build and file loading)

paths.path: Official macOS FBNeo currently supports keyboard and mouse using the standard FinalBurn layout; joysticks are explicitly unsupported.
paths.naming: Keyboard uses standard FinalBurn layout; there is no joystick profile file in the official macOS build.

paths.path: Game/NVRAM and memory-card data are managed by the macOS FBNeo build's support data; preserve the app data plus any user-selected card files.
paths.naming: Driver/game-defined save data; memory cards are user-selected files.

paths.path: FBNeo native save states use the same .fs state concept and slots as the upstream frontend, subject to the macOS build's support directory.
paths.naming: .fs states and .fr input recordings; keyboard shortcuts follow FinalBurn where implemented.

paths.path: Required parent/BIOS archives (for example Neo Geo sets) must be in the same directory as the selected game archive in the official macOS launcher.
paths.naming: Driver-defined ROM set names/checksums; no universal BIOS checksum.

paths.path: No external decryption key file documented.

linux-flatpak.reason: The FBNeo project documents native SDL builds and the libretro core, but no official standalone FBNeo Flatpak package.
